launches.title: Cardinal: AI Platform for Precision Outbound
launches.body:
**Hey YC! We're Devi and Jianna - the founders of Cardinal.**

**TL;DR:** Cardinal is the AI platform for precision outbound. We run outbound for 40+ YC companies, like Mintlify, Greptile, and Luminai.

**The Problem**

“Spray and Pray” outbound is dead. The best teams at outbound do it with extreme precision. Finding things in common with your customers, staying in touch with them through their content, mapping inbound from signups and ads, tracking website visitors, monitoring various signals, etc. This sounds great in theory, but in reality involves stringing together 10+ tools and hiring a GTM engineer. 

That’s where Cardinal comes in. 

**What can you do with Cardinal**

Cardinal is an AI platform for precision outbound. Our agents can create workflows that normally require the work of fulltime GTM engineers. 

**🔍 Find the perfect leads:** Whether you need to map your entire TAM, enrich folks going to a conference, invite leads to a dinner you’re hosting, etc. Cardinal finds the most precise leads for you to reach out to.

📡 **Monitor content from your customers:**  Our agents continuously track what your prospects are posting, sharing, and engaging with on social media, so you can stay up to date on what they are doing. 

✂️ **Snippets that write themselves** Cardinal generates hyper-specific snippets based on things you and your team have in common with your customers. 

⚙️ **Build full workflows** Design end-to-end outbound workflows across email and linkedin. 

📥 **Capture inbound too** Set up website visitors, product signups, social media likes and comments, Ad impressions, etc. → qualify it and add them to your sequences.

**The Team**

We’re Devi and Jianna - we are 2x YC founders (S23, W26). Our last company, Leafpress, was an energy software company - we closed folks like Lindt, Honeywell, etc. from cold outbound. We’re Harvard and MIT CS alums. 

**Our Asks**

**If you are a sales leader wanting to add agents to your workflow and finally build a strong outbound engine, please talk with us - we’d love to help.**

 -Devi and Jianna

launches.title: Cardinal: The Most Accurate Document Intelligence API
launches.tagline: Cardinal turns unstructured, messy documents into perfectly structured data, instantly and with unmatched accuracy.
launches.body:
**Hey everyone – Devi and Jianna here** 👋🏼

We met while studying at MIT and Harvard, and our last company processed utility data at scale. The biggest bottleneck? OCR. It was terrible - especially for complex documents where preserving structure was critical. After years of wrestling with these OCR limitations, we decided to build something better. That became Cardinal.

📃 **The Problem**

 Most enterprise knowledge is trapped in PDFs and other unstructured formats -  medical forms, contracts, invoices, insurance claims, financial statements, packing slips, etc. 

OCR is _not_ a solved problem:

* LLMs hallucinate and can fabricate data
* Annotations, checkmarks, and handwritten notes get ignored
* Tables, charts, and images are dropped entirely
* Layouts are mangled, breaking document structure and making the output unusable for code, retrieval, or downstream automation. Preserving the semantic meaning of the document is nearly impossible.

\
🚀 **Our Solution**

Cardinal has 2 finetuned models. The first model, _Document-to-Markdown_, accurately converts even complex documents into clean, structured Markdown. The second model, _Markdown-to-Code_, then turns that Markdown into ready-to-use HTML, preserving the original formatting and hierarchy exactly.

Put simply, we can help you:

* Reliably extract structured data from the most complex PDFs
* Preserve exact layouts for retrieval, search, and downstream LLM workflows
* Convert charts into data, summarize images, and parse complex tables
* Run natural language extractions for any field without brittle regex or templates

Full Demo video: [https://youtu.be/RouYM1cKGXI](https://youtu.be/RouYM1cKGXI?feature=shared)

🔗 **Demo** \
Try it [here](https://dashboard.trycardinal.ai/) - we’d love your feedback!

🙏🏼 **Our Ask**

**If you or your team works in enterprise and deals with complex document workflows, we’d love to chat.**

**📅 Here’s our [Calendly](https://calendly.com/leafpress/demo-chat): Book time here or email us at [team@trycardinal.ai](mailto:team@trycardinal.ai).**

launches.title: 🍁 AI Copilot for Energy Data
launches.tagline: We process & manage energy data with AI
launches.body:
**🏭 The Problem**\
The modern energy grid is broken. AI and other energy-intensive industries are driving unprecedented demand, and businesses are left struggling to manage and optimize their energy usage. Tens of thousands of companies rely on energy as a top budget item—whether for managing consumption, paying bills on time, avoiding overpayments, or planning retrofits. But current solutions are fragmented, manual, and inefficient. Companies lack a true copilot for managing their energy data.

**💡 Our Solution**\
Leafpress is building the first AI Energy Intelligence Platform—a seamless solution to centralize, analyze, and act on mission-critical energy data. Here’s what sets us apart:

* Centralized Data Management:\
  Users can onboard their data in seconds. Our integrations with utility providers and custom upload portals bring together siloed data across thousands of properties or facilities, providing a single source of truth.
* AI-Powered Analytics:\
  Traditional energy management systems fail to provide actionable insights. Leafpress leverages OCR and AI to deliver accurate, real-time analytics. Businesses can instantly understand costs, usage trends, and savings opportunities across their portfolio.
* Automated Actions:\
  Leafpress doesn’t just analyze data; it acts on it. From avoiding billing errors to optimizing energy spend and forecasting needs, our platform saves businesses countless hours while reducing costs.

With our solution, businesses can stop firefighting and start managing energy like the strategic asset it is.

**Who Are We?**\
We’re Devi and Jianna.

* **Devi** is a Harvard CS alum with deep expertise in energy systems, having worked on the energy teams at P&G & Spotify before Leafpress.
* **Jianna** is an MIT CS alum with years of experience building software at Meta, DoorDash, and Nvidia.
